thread:
maria (CS): quick weekly check-in for EchoHealth prefetch cohort. focus: caching + batching effectiveness, usage trends, latency, error rate, and cost/1k tokens. renewal call in 3 weeks so want concise status.
jordan (SE): TL;DR — hit rate up, cost down, p50 better, p95 spikes during bursts.
maria (CS): numbers for last 7d vs prior 7d: hit rate 46% (was 32%), avg batch size 5.8 (was 3.9), cost/1k tokens $1.95 (was $2.60). p50 170ms (was 210ms), p95 1.2s (was 900ms). error rate 0.9% (was 0.2%) — spike correlated with midday yesterday.
sam (SRE): where are the spikes coming from? logs show a heavy tail from mobile clients sending many short prompts. propose small increase to max batching window and raise min batch size.
jordan (SE): tested config locally: ```
max_batch_delay_ms: 12
min_batch_size: 4
route_overrides:
  /generate/v1/echo:
    prefix_cache_ttl_s: 60
```
that route-level TTL was 10s previously; bump to 60s produced most of the hit-rate uplift.
elliot (PM): noted that EchoHealth turned on streaming for downstream clients last week — that increases request count and can push p95 even if perceived latency is OK.
lina (CS Manager): is this safe to present to customer? they asked for concrete cost wins. also want to check renewal risk — numbers look better but error uptick is concerning.
maria (CS): ran a short A/B overnight (25% traffic). results: cache_hits 1.2M, cache_misses 1.4M => hit rate ~46%. estimate monthlyized cost/1k tokens fell ~25% with these changes. attaching rough calc in thread.
jordan (SE): one more datapoint — avg prompt length unchanged, so batching gains come from combining many small requests into batches of 4-8 tokens processed together.
sam (SRE): watchlist: 5xx increased to 0.9% during the roll — correlated with a couple of GPU OOMs on the dedicated pool. opened INC-2023 and bumped pool retry backoff. set temporary alert: 5xx > 1.5% => auto-rollback.
elliot (PM): action items: Lina to draft a one-pager for EchoHealth highlighting the cost delta and latency tradeoffs; Jordan to stage rollout to 75% after another 24h of observation; Sam to monitor errors and keep INC updated; Maria to produce a 2-slide summary for the renewal call.
maria (CS): I'll have slides ready by tomorrow EOD. quick ask: can analytics retention be bumped to 90d for this account so we can show longer trend history?
sam (SRE): done — retention extended to 90d for EchoHealth metrics and added alert `echo-cost-spike` for delta > 30% week-over-week.
deploy-bot: Rollout started for /generate/v1/echo prefix-cache TTL change to 75% at 1814203600
jordan (SE): pausing criteria in place — will pause rollout if regen rate > 3/min or 5xx spikes above threshold.
lina (CS Manager): :thumbsup: thanks team. Maria I'll book the renewal prep sync with EchoHealth Wed 10am PT. if numbers remain steady we'll mark renewal risk as green.
